purpose: Expresses the initial hardening rate θ_0 as a function of the DRV coefficient ζ_v, the saturation stress σ_s, and the yield stress σ_0.

symbols.meaning: coefficient corresponding to dynamic recovery (DRV), only affected by deformation parameters

unmapped: The equation is cited from the work of Zeng et al. (2019).
In the equation, ζ_v corresponds to ζ_ν (the DRV coefficient) described in the 'where' clause of the context.
θ_0 is mainly influenced by the deformation temperature (per Eqs. (2) and (3)).
Under varying deformation conditions, θ_0^(ν) is taken equal to θ_0 under constant conditions (Eq. 21).
